name: OpenAI Whisper small.en offline model
versioning: The GitHub Action resolves the current official small.en URL from openai/whisper and treats the SHA-256 fingerprint embedded in that URL as the model version. A new release is created only when that fingerprint has not already been published here.

offline.runtime_note: A compatible Whisper runtime and its dependencies, such as Python, openai-whisper, PyTorch, and FFmpeg, must already be installed or cached locally.

python_example:
import whisper
model = whisper.load_model("small.en", download_root="./whisper-small-en")
result = model.transcribe("audio.mp3", language="en")
print(result["text"])
